parameters.name: workspaceId
parameters.description: The workspace to search. You must be a member of it. If you send none, the server uses the workspace of your session.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The maximum number of results, from 1 to 100.

parameters.name: threshold
parameters.description: The maximum cosine distance for a match by meaning, from 0 to 2. A lower value gives fewer, closer matches.

parameters.name: stateCategory
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of workflow categories. Send it to get only issues in these categories.

parameters.name: moduleIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of module ids. An issue matches if it names one of these modules. The server ignores a module of another workspace.

parameters.name: capabilityId
parameters.description: One capability id. An issue matches if it delivers this capability. The server ignores a capability of another workspace.
